decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system remains tightly aligned with the firm's premium office competence and continuing demand for flexible, high-quality workplaces.
A chair family is a staple of the firm's configurable interior portfolio and likely continues to support both residential and contract cross-selling.
Floor cushions are a more peripheral textile niche for this manufacturer, and after several years they are the easiest line to prune if sales did not justify the added complexity.
The upholstered sofa fits the firm's living and lounge identity, but its weaker prominence makes it more vulnerable than the stronger office-led launches.
The high standing table still suits collaborative office and conference settings and can be retained with relatively low strategic risk inside the core range.
Although rugs are more distant from the historic core, the collection supports the firm's move toward complete interior solutions and was introduced as a strategic flagship.
